after.name: ต้องทำให้ billing note ต้องสามารถดึง vendor bill และ credit note มาทำได้
after.x_studio_test_steps: PASS - BN APD/CN payment net due verified
after.x_studio_test_step:
1. Open Purchase/Accounting vendor billing note flow on server14 database goldmints_uat.
  2. Select existing posted Vendor Bill and Vendor Credit Note for the same vendor.
  3. Create Vendor Billing Note from selected APD/CN documents.
  4. Confirm the Billing Note, then open Register Payment from the Billing Note.
  5. Verify Vendor Bills, Credit Notes, Net Due, and Payment Difference in the payment wizard.
  6. Regression check: Purchase Order Status Report / APD/CN source must still be usable for Billing Note creation.
after.x_studio_expected_result:
Expected Result

  • Vendor Billing Note can include both Vendor Bill and Vendor Credit Note.
  • Billing Note net due equals Vendor Bills minus Credit Notes.
  • Register Payment amount uses the net due amount and Payment Difference must be 0.00.
  • Existing vendor bill / credit note fields and links are not overwritten incorrectly.

Actual Test Result - PASS (server14 retest evidence)

  • Billing Note: BN/2026/06/0069, state billed, payment status not paid.
  • Vendor Bills: 500.00, Credit Notes: 321.00, Net Due: 179.00, Residual Net Due: 179.00.
  • Register Payment wizard account.payment.register:3170 showed Amount 179.00 and Payment Difference 0.00.
  • Related records: vendor.billing.note:69, account.move ids 69804 and 69799, active move lines 214213 and 214203.

  • Credit Note links 2 returns: GMP/R-OUT/00011 (stock.picking:10818) and GMP/R-OUT/00012 (stock.picking:10819).
  • Both return pickings are done and vendor_credit_note_count = 1.

after.x_studio_test_step:

  2. Verify scheduled actions related to contract expiry and reminder.
  3. Check active flag, interval, model, and nextcall for each scheduled action.
  4. Confirm the trigger is configured on the Contract Document model and can run automatically.
  5. Regression check: the cron setup must not disable unrelated accounting accrual scheduled actions.
after.x_studio_expected_result:

  • Contract expiry/reminder triggers exist and are active.
  • Triggers run automatically on the expected schedule.
  • Configuration uses the correct model and does not conflict with unrelated scheduled actions.

Actual Test Result - PASS (server14 retest evidence)

  • Contract Auto-Expire - Daily (ir.cron:70) is active, interval 1 day, model Contract Document.
  • Contract Expiry Reminder - Daily (ir.cron:69) is active, interval 1 day, model Contract Document.
  • Related Accrual Auto Reverse scheduled action (ir.cron:77) remains active.
  • Evidence captured from server14 retest file dated 2026-06-07.

  • Advance supports bank draft purchase workflow similar to Cheque.
  • Required bank draft fields are available before posting/accounting.

  • No completed server14 UI/UAT evidence was found in the current assigned tester retest records for this task.

  • Do not mark PASS until a real Advance bank draft document is processed end to end and compared with Cheque behavior.
